fields.label: Aes Encryption Enabled
fields.help: If enabled, AES encryption will be enabled for SMB communication.

fields.label: Kerberos Ad Name
fields.help: Name of the active directory machine.

fields.label: Kerberos Kdc IP
fields.help: IP address of the KDC server (usually same the DC).

fields.label: Ldap Over TLS Enabled
fields.help: Specifies whether or not the LDAP traffic needs to be secured via TLS.

fields.label: Ldap Signing Enabled
fields.help: Specifies whether or not the LDAP traffic needs to be signed.

fields.label: Local Nfs Users With Ldap Allowed
fields.help: If enabled, NFS client local users can also (in addition to LDAP users) access the NFS volumes.

fields.label: Organizational Unit
fields.help: The Organizational Unit (OU) within the Windows Active Directory where machines will be created.

fields.label: Server Root Ca Certificate

fields.label: Site Name
fields.help: The Active Directory site the service will limit Domain Controller discovery to.
